title: Jordan from Sonica predicts the next day's conflict in the sky

tellings.quote: Jordan, our leading specialist from Sonica, came up to me and Alex and said, "Hey, tomorrow we will see conflict in the sky.

plain: During a 2025 field operation by Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call UFOs to appear, a team member named Jordan Jose predicted that the next day they would see "conflict in the sky." A Skywatcher member named James Valor tells Michels that Jose, whom he calls "our leading specialist from Sonica," came up to him and a colleague named Alex and said so. If the prediction came true, it would suggest Jose could sense such events before they happened.
